description: This file defines a wizard for creating invoices from selected timesheet lines in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including methods for fetching accounts and creating invoices with detailed line items.

classes.name: invoice_create
classes.description: Wizard class for creating invoices from timesheet lines

methods.name: _get_accounts
methods.description: Fetches account IDs related to selected analytic lines, raising a warning if any are already invoiced.

methods.name: _do_create
methods.description: Creates invoices based on selected analytic lines, associating invoice lines with products, taxes, and notes, then returns an action to display the created invoices.
